authenticity_review: The image suffers from significant structural artifacts typical of AI generation. There is severe 'fusion' between the central and right-hand trucks, where their bodies merge into a single indistinct mass without clear boundaries. The leftmost truck exhibits physics-defying geometry, with wheels that appear disconnected or melted into the chassis rather than mounted on axles. While the wood texture is convincing, the structural integrity of the objects is compromised.

Structural collapse in wheel/axle assembly of left truck
Missing functional details (headlights, tailgate) due to stylization/fusion
